examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A customers grid with a text, a select, a number and a boolean column and a read-only ID, the first column frozen. Click a cell or move with the arrow keys, press Enter or start typing to edit, Enter to commit and move down, Escape to cancel; Space toggles Active; Shift with an arrow selects a range that Ctrl+C copies as tab-separated text.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DataGrid from '@aziontech/webkit/data-grid'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const rows = ref([
    { id: '1', name: 'Acme Inc.', plan: 'business', seats: 12, active: true },
    { id: '2', name: 'Jane Doe', plan: 'free', seats: 1, active: true },
    { id: '3', name: 'John Smith', plan: 'pro', seats: 3, active: false },
    { id: '4', name: 'Priya Patel', plan: 'pro', seats: 5, active: true },
    { id: '5', name: 'Sam Lee', plan: 'free', seats: 1, active: false }
  ])

  const columns = [
    { id: 'name', header: 'Name', type: 'text', width: 200 },
    {
      id: 'plan',
      header: 'Plan',
      type: 'select',
      options: [
        { label: 'Free', value: 'free' },
        { label: 'Pro', value: 'pro' },
        { label: 'Business', value: 'business' }
      ]
    },
    { id: 'seats', header: 'Seats', type: 'number', align: 'end', width: 120 },
    { id: 'active', header: 'Active', type: 'boolean', width: 120 },
    { id: 'id', header: 'ID', editable: false, width: 96 }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <DataGrid
    v-model="rows"
    :columns="columns"
    aria-label="Customers"
    frozen-first-column
  />
</template>

examples.name: RowSelection
examples.summary: `enable-row-selection` adds a checkbox column with Select all, bound with `v-model:row-selection`. The toolbar slot's `add` and `remove` emit `row-add` and `row-delete` with the selected rows, and the page writes the new rows to the `v-model`.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import DataGrid from '@aziontech/webkit/data-grid'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const rows = ref([
    { id: 'r1', host: 'app.example.com', ttl: 3600, proxied: true },
    { id: 'r2', host: 'api.example.com', ttl: 300, proxied: true },
    { id: 'r3', host: 'docs.example.com', ttl: 3600, proxied: false }
  ])
  const selection = ref({})
  let next = 4

  const columns = [
    { id: 'host', header: 'Host', width: 220 },
    { id: 'ttl', header: 'TTL (seconds)', type: 'number', align: 'end', width: 140 },
    { id: 'proxied', header: 'Proxied', type: 'boolean', width: 120 }
  ]

  const addRow = () => {
    rows.value = [...rows.value, { id: `r${next++}`, host: '', ttl: 3600, proxied: false }]
  }
  const deleteRows = (event, removed) => {
    const ids = new Set(removed.map((row) => row.id))
    rows.value = rows.value.filter((row) => !ids.has(row.id))
    selection.value = {}
  }
</script>

<template>
  <DataGrid
    v-model="rows"
    v-model:row-selection="selection"
    :columns="columns"
    aria-label="DNS records"
    enable-row-selection
    @row-add="addRow"
    @row-delete="deleteRows"
  >
    <template #toolbar="{ add, remove, selectedCount }">
      <Button
        label="Add row"
        icon="ai ai-plus"
        kind="outlined"
        size="small"
        @click="add"
      />
      <Button
        label="Delete rows"
        kind="outlined"
        size="small"
        :disabled="selectedCount === 0"
        @click="remove"
      />
    </template>
  </DataGrid>
</template>

examples.name: Readonly
examples.summary: `readonly` while a save runs or for people who may not edit: no editor opens and every cell reads as read-only, while the cursor, the range selection and copy keep working.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DataGrid from '@aziontech/webkit/data-grid'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const rows = ref([
    { id: '1', path: '/assets/logo.svg', size: 4096, cached: true },
    { id: '2', path: '/index.html', size: 18230, cached: false },
    { id: '3', path: '/app.js', size: 254880, cached: true }
  ])

  const columns = [
    { id: 'path', header: 'Path', width: 220 },
    { id: 'size', header: 'Size (bytes)', type: 'number', align: 'end', width: 140 },
    { id: 'cached', header: 'Cached', type: 'boolean', width: 120 }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <DataGrid
    v-model="rows"
    :columns="columns"
    aria-label="Objects"
    readonly
  />
</template>
